mutation.description: Kept the DDR clock period but replaced its phase-shifted waveform with a zero-based 50 percent waveform.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: A 50-percent-duty 8 ns clock with waveform {0 4} correctly provides both rising and falling edges. Negedge RTL capture does not imply that create_clock should invert its waveform; rising-edge launch external I/O delays can legitimately impose half-cycle paths. No external falling-edge launch contract is supplied to contradict those delays.
The supplied 8 ns clock with edges at 0 and 4 ns supports falling-edge capture. No source waveform contract in the inputs contradicts it; the original label invented a phase requirement.
